newsitem.title: UK: US stocks mostly flat in London, Boeing firms.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mostly flat in London, Boeing firms.

text.p: U.S. stocks were narrowly mixed in London on Wednesday in thin and featureless dealings after Tuesday's stunning recovery on Wall Street.
"There's not much trade at all. The market is just consolidating," said one London dealer.
On Globex, September S&P 500 index futures were down 0.55 point to 904.45 at 1029 GMT, while September long bond futures trading down 7/32 to 111-31/32.
The Dow surged 153.80 points to 7,758.06 on Tuesday - the third biggest point advance so far this year - nearly erasing Monday's 192-point drop.
"I think we'll see a mixed or maybe slightly weaker open on the Street," the dealer said.

Among individual stocks, shares in Boeing Co firmed $1/8 to $55-1/8 in London, reacting to a Wall Street Journal report that said the aircraft manufacturer may change its sole-supplier pacts with three U.S. airlines in an attempt to pacify European leaders and remove a major obstacle to its acquisition with McDonnell Douglas Corp.

Shares in Philip Morris Cos Inc advanced $1/8 to $44-5/16 after a report in the New York Times said the company is expected to pick up about $6.5 billion of the initial $10 billion payment called for under the recent settlement struck with cigarette makers.
Shares in Mobil Corp were up $1/2 to $71-1/2 on a post-split basis.
Technology and pharmaceutical shares, which led Tuesday's rebound on Wall Street, were trading within $1/8 of their New York closing levels, dealers said.
